# Pineda Heating & Air

> Heating & air conditioning based in Garden Ridge, Texas. Chaun Pineda and his crew repair and install heating and air for homes and businesses around Schertz, New Braunfels and Seguin, and customers call them honest, quick and easy to talk to.

## Services
- AC repair: Chaun finds the problem, explains it and gets the air running again, often within hours of your call.
- Second opinions: Told you need a whole new unit? Chaun will take an honest second look first.
- New system installs: New AC and heating systems put in cleanly, with the crew cleaning up before they leave.
- Heating repair: Heaters and furnaces fixed so the house stays warm when the weather turns.
- Maintenance & commercial: Regular maintenance for home and business units, from the same people every time.

## About
Pineda Heating and Air is a licensed and insured heating and air company run by Chaun Pineda, based in the Garden Ridge area between Schertz and New Braunfels. Chaun is on the jobs himself, with his crew alongside. Most customers find Pineda through a friend or neighbor. The company does repairs, maintenance and new installs for homes and businesses, has handled the HVAC side of home remodels, and shows up in the community too: sponsoring Seguin youth baseball, buying at Comal County 4-H livestock auctions and riding in hometown parades.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can Pineda give me a second opinion on a replacement?
  A: Yes. One customer was told by another company they needed a whole new unit. Chaun had their AC running again in about an hour.
- Q: Do you come out on weekends?
  A: Office hours are Monday to Friday 8 to 5 and Saturday 9 to noon. Reviewers describe Chaun coming out on a weekend with temperatures over 100 to get a rental cooling again.
- Q: Do you work on business HVAC units?
  A: Yes. Pineda repairs, maintains and installs units for local businesses as well as homes.
- Q: Can you handle the HVAC for our remodel?
  A: Yes. Pineda has handled the HVAC portion of home remodels in the area.
- Q: Is Pineda Heating and Air licensed and insured?
  A: Yes. Pineda Heating and Air is licensed and insured.
